name: Leading Evasion
description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage on a successful save and only half damage on a failed save. If any creatures within 5 feet of you are making the same save, you can have them share in the benefit provided you aren't Incapacitated.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
